entries.title: II Timothy 3:1
segments: ¶But know this, that in the last days perilous times will come:

entries.title: II Timothy 3:2
segments: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:3
segments: unloving, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, brutal, despisers of good,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:4
segments: traitors, headstrong, haughty, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:5
segments: having a form of godliness but denying its power. And from such people turn away!

entries.title: II Timothy 3:6
segments: For of this sort are those who creep into households and make captives of gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:7
segments: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:8
segments: Now as Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, disapproved concerning the faith;

entries.title: II Timothy 3:9
segments: but they will progress no further, for their folly will be manifest to all, as theirs also was.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:10
segments: ¶But you have carefully followed my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, perseverance,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:11
segments: persecutions, afflictions, which happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra--what persecutions I endured. And out of [them] all the Lord delivered me.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:12
segments: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:13
segments: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:14
segments: But you must continue in the things which you have learned and been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned [them],

entries.title: II Timothy 3:15
segments: and that from childhood you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:16
segments: All Scripture [is] given by inspiration of God, and [is] profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:17
segments: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
